summary: @servicetitan/navigation 14.1.5 preinstall drops Bun runtime to execute obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs is obfuscated (hex-mangled identifiers, string-array indirection) and at install time downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases into a temp directory, unzips it, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a shipped 727 KB payload file math_init.js. math_init.js is heavily obfuscated (obfuscator.io-style rotated string array, large constants array, hex-mangled identifiers, string decoder) and cannot be interpreted as ordinary source. Fetching an alternate language runtime at install time solely to execute an opaque bundled blob bypasses Node-based scanning and has no relationship to the package's advertised purpose (a React navigation component library). The package presents as a ServiceTitan design-system component library, but the surrounding tsx component tree is decorative cover for the preinstall dropper.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
